script signs organized in columns/registers adjacent to figural imagery
large seated/standing principal figure with smaller subsidiary figures

justification: Both surfaces combine profile human figures with a dense, orderly field of small script-like signs laid out in blocks or registers immediately adjacent to the figural imagery, and both pair a principal figure with smaller subsidiary figures. But the depicted content diverges sharply: A shows one dominant, elaborately costumed figure with towering plumed headdress and beaded regalia in high, ornate relief occupying the centre, while B shows several small, spare, linear figures seated or kneeling at offering tables scattered around the margins of the text, with no elaborate costume and a quite different placement hierarchy.
